evidence.why: Complete callback shows the gate, argument lists, reset, reload and decrement.

facts.rationale: Corrects the existing claim that the command variable is forwarded to the effect helper while preserving both independent branches and their exact arguments.
facts.value: Obtains the Item from gobj and tests xDB0_itcmd_var1. When nonzero, it calls it_8027ADEC with effect ID 0x462, gobj, dynamic bone 5 and scale 1.4f, then clears the command variable; the command value itself is not forwarded. Independently, a nonpositive freezer.x60 causes a root-JObj lookup, reload from special attribute xC, and an effect-0x461 request with gobj, the root joint and scale 1.4f, followed by return. A positive timer is decremented by one.

evidence.why: Entry and restart clear var1; physics independently consumes var0 and tests var1; animation checks the top boundary.

facts.rationale: Adds the omitted restart lifetime exception and repeated-trigger behavior rather than describing acceleration as unconditional after the first launch.
facts.value: State-2 entry and animation restart clear xDB0_itcmd_var1. Each physics invocation with nonzero xDAC_itcmd_var0 sets vertical velocity to attribute x4, clears that trigger and sets xDB0_itcmd_var1. A separate following branch adds attribute x8 whenever xDB0_itcmd_var1 is nonzero, including the trigger invocation. With both flags zero, this callback leaves vertical velocity unchanged. Repeated triggers reseed velocity; continued acceleration lasts only while its gate remains set, and state-2 animation restart clears that gate. The companion animation callback independently requests termination when pos.y strictly exceeds the stage's top blast-zone offset.
